title: Fabulous day trip
text: Our trip today was absolutely fabulous.  Our guide Monica was just amazing. We were very well looked after. Monica was very knowledgeable. The little boat trip was most enjoyable with Sangria at a cost of 1 euro! We would definitely recommend this trip, one not to be missed. Thank you Monica.

title: Very beautiful excursion on the Costa Brava
text:
We really loved this excursion on the Costa Brava. The guides were friendly, the explanations very clear, and the organization excellent. One of the guides also spoke a little French.

The only point to improve concerns the directions for the departure meeting point. I had to write to them to get more details. The meeting takes place at a bus station and you have to look at the indicator board to find the right platform number. This information could be given more clearly from the start.

title: The most caring tour operators I have encountered
text:
This tour is basically a follow the tour guide or do it yourself and meet up at a designated time. It includes a very nice boat ride plus 2 drop off at beaches or sightseeing opportunities. My partner just had surgery so we chose not to walk. We had lunch and took a local shuttle around to the walked city(not included) and just went shopping and enjoyed the sunshine at the other stops.

title: Amazing tour!
text: This was a must see tour from Barcelona. Beautiful coast and beaches along with historical sights as well. We opted for the drive to Lloret, and then boat ride to Tossa and it was exceptional. Our tour guide Monica was absolutely amazing!
